english.note: For ordinary physical departure or telling someone to go away, 走 is the all-purpose choice; in context it can also mean quitting a group or organization.

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for leaving or departing from a place or situation.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zau2 laa3

english.note: Use 走 as the all-purpose casual verb when someone is leaving or going away.

english.note: Use this for going or hurrying away, especially fleeing from trouble rather than literally running on foot.

exampleSentences.english: When the alarm went off, everyone had to run away.

english.note: Use this colloquial verb when “shoot” means leave quickly.
